mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indexes
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4.5% are associated with strong labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 3% YoY, the combined effect drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above $350 billion signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and post-shock recoveries
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS > 350B in post-shock recovery regimes, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% is associated with stable monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between CPIAUCSL and monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 signals strong labor market growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between PAYEMS and labor market growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 135,000, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 2.5% YoY, the combined effect drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential supply chain constraints.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
